scope: Exact 17-prime CRT and full-width selector encoding. CPU-only arithmetic; no private-key generation, encryption, or security-parameter changes.
centering: The mixed-radix digits of floor(M/2) are floor(p_i/2); compare from the highest digit. Weighted prefixes and signed correction are accumulated modulo the target torus, without approximate CRT.
tests: Trial-division primality and NTT root order for all 17 primes
32-bit Shoup multiplication against uint64 modulus oracle
Active-440-bit encoding against boost::multiprecision::cpp_int, including inactive high bits
Centered CRT against cpp_int on full 510-bit random values and both half-modulus boundaries
AVX2 bulk CRT including scalar tails, and complete scalar build with -mno-avx2
